events.headline: NDB reports ongoing recoveries and control improvements after Rs. 13.64bn fraud
events.summary: NDB said it is pursuing recoveries and legal or internal action after the fraud identified earlier in 2026. Its latest disclosure refers to a final forensic assessment of approximately Rs. 13.64 billion and describes continuing controls, technology and governance improvements. The disclosure does not quantify actual recoveries or provide a completion timetable.

events.headline: NDB Group Q3 profit declines 20.9%; bank-level profit Rs. 2.89bn
events.summary: NDB reported third-quarter Group profit attributable to shareholders of about Rs. 2.77 billion, 20.9% below its restated year-earlier result. The bank-level quarterly net profit was approximately Rs. 2.89 billion, down 8.9% year on year. Group and bank figures are different measures; the bank-level Rs. 2.9 billion result was reported in the earlier brief, while this article adds the Group comparison.

events.headline: Sri Lanka CERT warns of fake bank gift message targeting customer credentials
events.summary: Sri Lanka CERT warned that a purported Vap Poya reward offer attributed to an unnamed major bank is fraudulent. The warning says the circulating message may be designed to steal personal or banking credentials and compromise accounts. Customers were advised to avoid its links and verify promotions through official channels.

events.headline: Government agencies directed to remedy PHP vulnerabilities identified by CERT
events.summary: The Ministry of Digital Economy directed government institutions to take corrective action over two PHP vulnerabilities identified by Sri Lanka CERT. The instruction includes checking affected installations, applying security updates, inspecting logs and restricting internet exposure where systems cannot be patched. This is a follow-up government directive to an earlier CERT advisory, not a reported breach at a bank.

The initiative is administered using payment data supplied by banks and overseen by a multi-agency draw committee.

events.headline: Industrial Asphalts placed on CSE Watch List following auditor disclaimer
events.summary: Industrial Asphalts (Ceylon) PLC disputed its external auditor’s disclaimer of opinion on financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026. The development concerns listed-company reporting and investor-protection risks.

events.headline: President outlines Treasury position, possible SOE closures and higher capital spending
events.summary: At the Government Surveyors’ Association event, the President said the Treasury account was approaching a Rs. 1 trillion surplus, compared with a roughly Rs. 700 billion deficit in 2022. A Finance Ministry committee was considering closing or amalgamating 34 state institutions, while planned capital expenditure would rise from approximately Rs. 1.33 trillion in 2026 to Rs. 2 trillion in 2027. These are government statements and plans, not independently audited outturns.
